attributes.action: If the weather goes over 30 students get the day off school or half day.
attributes.background: I think when the weather goes over 30 degrees students should get a half day or should get the day of school due to students being uncomftable at school and due to congested calssrooms its hard for students to focus, also students cant learn fully in an uncomftable enviroment.

rejection.details:
